name: White-naped Pigeon
rangeDescription: Western cameroon; eastern democratic republic of the congo, western uganda, and western rwanda
description: A dark maroon-gray pigeon with a hind-crown and nape that are white in the male and gray in the female. At close quarters the bill can be seen to have a black base with a red-yellow tip, and the legs are reddish-purple.

name: Kai Cicadabird
rangeDescription: Seram laut islands (gorong, manawoka, maar, and panjang), banda, watubela (tiur), tayandu (manggur), and kai islands, and eastern lesser sundas (romang, damar, and tanimbar)
description: A thrush-sized songbird. Male is entirely glossy-black, while distinctive female has a gray head, a brown back, and a buff underside with extensive barring.

name: Orange-bellied Parrot
rangeDescription: Breeds southwestern tasmania; winters to coastal southeastern australia
description: Small grassy-green parrot that feeds on the ground. Bright green and yellow with blue wings and yellow lower belly with a central orange patch, yellowish throat, and thin mid-blue line between eyes.

name: Moustached Hawk-Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Southern myanmar including mergui archipelago, malay peninsula, sumatra, and borneo
description: Large hawk-like cuckoo, dark gray-brown above with streaked underparts and long tail with broad dark bands. Distinctly falcon-like facial pattern distinguishes this species from other hawk-cuckoos.

name: Icterine Warbler
rangeDescription: Central europe to western siberia and northern iran; winters to southern africa
description: Medium-sized warbler, light olive-brown above and yellowish below. Distinctive features include longish, daggerlike bill, long primary projection in the wings, and square tail.

name: Bornean Green-Magpie
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern borneo
description: Incredibly beautiful; grass-green with black mask, wine-red wings, and pale tertials. Unlike Common Green-Magpie, Bornean has pale eyes and lacks white-tipped dark tertials.

name: Cinnamon Tanager
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (southern pará, central maranhão, and pernambuco southward to santa catarina)
description: Large tanager with a thick gray bill. Note the black patch in front of the eye, a largely cinnamon head, breast and vent, and gray belly, wings, and tail.

name: Collared Crow
rangeDescription: Central and eastern china to northern vietnam; hainan and taiwan
description: By far the most distinctive crow of farmland, fields, and other open spaces: adults black with white hindneck connecting to white breast band. Superficially similar to adult Daurian Jackdaw, but the latter is more compact and smaller, with pale plumage extending through the belly.

name: Little Brown Bustard
rangeDescription: Acacia and thornbush of eastern ethiopia and northern somalia
description: A small and relatively short-necked bustard. The male has a black-and-gray pattern on the head, while the female is plainer, but with abundant white spotting.

name: Bay-capped Wren-Spinetail
rangeDescription: Far southern brazil to uruguay and central argentina
description: Small, with a long spiky tail. Has a brown-streaked black back contrasting with a cinnamon crown and pale underparts.

name: Bulwer's Pheasant
rangeDescription: Submontane forest of interior borneo
description: Uncommon, medium-sized pheasant. Male is almost unbelievable-looking; an immense fan of a snow-white tail sticks out of a rotund, coal-black body.

name: Genovesa Ground-Finch
rangeDescription: Galapagos (genovesa)
description: A wedge-billed Galápagos finch found only on Genovesa Island. Formerly considered a subspecies of Sharp-beaked Ground-Finch, and likewise has a sharp, thin bill with nearly straight edges.

name: Royal Tern
rangeDescription: Breeds from southwestern usa (southern california) to northwestern mexico (south to sinaloa), and eastern usa through the west indies to the guianas and possibly brazil, wintering southward to peru, uruguay, and argentina; also a disjunct breeding population in northern argentina and southern brazil
description: Large tern, found strictly in coastal areas. Feeds in open ocean and saltwater bays, where it flies high above the water looking for small fish.

name: Slaty-headed Parakeet
rangeDescription: Himalayas (afghanistan to northern india, nepal, and western assam)
description: A medium-sized parakeet with a bluish-gray head, green body, red bill, and yellow-tipped tail. Males and females are alike, except that males have a red patch on the shoulder.

name: Fairy Prion
rangeDescription: Breeds scattered subtropical and subantarctic islands
description: The smallest of the six prion species, the fairy prion is often seen making shallow dives or seizing food from the surface in large flocks at sea. It is very similar to other prion species, with a dark “M'' stretching across the back from wingtip to wingtip and a black tip to the upper tail.

name: Bare-eyed Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern argentina
description: Medium-sized, terrestrial dove of the high Andes in NW Argentina. Note bright orange-red facial skin and plain wings.

name: Bioko Batis
rangeDescription: Bioko (gulf of guinea)
description: The only batis on Bioko. Patterned like a typical batis, with a white belly and throat, black wings with a white bar, and a black face.

name: Elfin Myzomela
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed mountains of new guinea
description: A tiny honeyeater of mid-montane forest canopy and villages. Brown with a whitish belly and fairly short curved bill.

name: Araripe Manakin
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (chapada do araripe in ceará)
description: Strikingly beautiful white manakin with a red crown and black tail and flight feathers. Females are olive-green, paler below; note the short crest above the bill.

name: Tristram's Starling
rangeDescription: Dead sea valley and western arabia to yemen and southern oman
description: Large, long-winged, and long-tailed starling. In flight, shows large orange wing panels.
